hoaxes.title: OpenAI adds an 'I'm not sure' button that forces GPT-6.2 Astra to admit doubt on demand
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The Decoder reports GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol give shorter answers but score lower than Claude on transparency.

hoaxes.title: Prime Video will only stream Blade Runner 2099 after sunset to match the show's mood
hoaxes.truth: Made up. All eight episodes of Blade Runner 2099 arrive on Prime Video on November 25 as a normal binge release.

hoaxes.title: Mega Man: Dual Override's collector's edition comes with an inflatable Boat Man pool toy
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Capcom revealed Boat Man as the game's sixth Robot Master; the game is due in 2027 on Switch and Switch 2.

hoaxes.title: Microsoft To Do becomes a paid app that charges a small fee for every task you complete
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Microsoft plans to retire To Do next year and points users to Planner, which needs a business or education licence.
